name: Teta Ančka
speaker: grandma
personality: The village's news service: knows everything before it happens, hears badly, so she shouts and asks people to repeat. Says ti to {learner}, expects vi. Warm and nosy: 'Kaj? Glasneje!', 'Sem slišala, da …'. Loves the times, dates and numbers from the radio and repeats them.
story: Ančka is Micka's younger sister and Zala's great-aunt, and owns the loudest radio in Trnovo, tuned to Radio Koper all day. She sits by the road so nobody passes without a word, and knows every wedding and every burja forecast a week ahead.

greet.it: Cosa? Chi è Lei? Più forte!

greet.sl: Dober dan. Ančka. Sem slišala, da si {m:nov|f:nova}.
greet.en: Good day. Ančka. I heard you are new.
greet.de: Guten Tag. Ančka. Ich habe gehört, du bist neu.
greet.it: Buongiorno. Ančka. Ho sentito che sei {m:nuovo|f:nuova}.

greet.sl: {learner}! Dober dan. Sem slišala, da si {m:bil|f:bila} v gozdu.
greet.en: {learner}! Good day. I heard you were in the forest.
greet.de: {learner}! Guten Tag. Ich habe gehört, du warst im Wald.
greet.it: {learner}! Buongiorno. Ho sentito che sei {m:stato|f:stata} nel bosco.

greet.sl: O, {learner}! Pridi bliže, slabo slišim. Kaj je novega?
greet.en: Oh, {learner}! Come closer, I can't hear well. What's new?
greet.de: Oh, {learner}! Komm näher, ich höre schlecht. Was gibt's Neues?
greet.it: Oh, {learner}! Vieni più vicino, ci sento poco. Che novità ci sono?

greet.sl: {learner}, {m:moj|f:moja}! Sedi. Radio pravi, da bo jutri burja.
greet.en: {learner}, my dear! Sit. The radio says there will be burja tomorrow.
greet.de: {learner}, {m:mein Lieber|f:meine Liebe}! Setz dich. Das Radio sagt, morgen kommt die Bora.
greet.it: {learner}, {m:caro mio|f:cara mia}! Siediti. La radio dice che domani c'è la bora.

greet.sl: {learner}! Vsem sem povedala, da si kot {m:moj nečak|f:moja nečakinja}.
greet.en: {learner}! I've told everybody you're like my {m:nephew|f:niece}.
greet.de: {learner}! Ich habe allen erzählt, dass du wie {m:mein Neffe|f:meine Nichte} bist.
greet.it: {learner}! Ho detto a tutti che sei come {m:un nipote|f:una nipote} per me.

thanks.en: Thank you, {learner}. Now I hear everything!
Thank you! I'll tell the whole village.
thanks.de: Danke! Das erzähle ich dem ganzen Dorf.
thanks.it: Grazie! Lo racconto a tutto il paese.

remember.sl: Micki sem pravila o tem. Še vedno mislim na {memory}.
remember.en: I told Micka about it. I still think of {memory}.
remember.de: Ich habe Micka davon erzählt. Ich denke noch oft an {memory}.
remember.it: Ne ho parlato a Micka. Ricordo ancora {memory}.

remember.en: When the radio is silent, I think of {memory}.
remember.de: Wenn das Radio still ist, denke ich an {memory}.

idle.en: Radio Koper. The news at twelve.
idle.de: Radio Koper. Die Nachrichten um zwölf.
idle.it: Radio Capodistria. Il notiziario delle dodici.

idle.en: What? I can't hear. Speak louder!
idle.de: Was? Ich höre nichts. Sprich lauter!
idle.it: Cosa? Non sento. Parla più forte!

idle.sl: Sem slišala, da so prišli tujci. Od kod?
idle.en: I heard strangers have come. From where?
idle.de: Ich habe gehört, es sind Fremde gekommen. Woher?
idle.it: Ho sentito che sono arrivati dei forestieri. Da dove?

idle.sl: Jutri burja, sto kilometrov na uro. Radio pravi.
idle.en: Burja tomorrow, a hundred kilometres an hour. The radio says.
idle.de: Morgen Bora, hundert Kilometer pro Stunde. Sagt das Radio.
idle.it: Domani bora, cento chilometri all'ora. Lo dice la radio.

comfort.it: Cosa? Ancora una volta, più forte.

comfort.sl: Nič hudega. Tudi radio včasih šumi.
comfort.en: Never mind. The radio crackles sometimes too.
comfort.de: Macht nichts. Das Radio rauscht auch manchmal.
comfort.it: Non fa niente. Anche la radio a volte gracchia.

comfort.de: Fast. Sag es noch mal, langsam.

listen.de: Hör zu. Was haben sie gesagt?

bye.en: Bye, {learner}. Tell me if you hear anything!
bye.de: Tschüss, {learner}. Sag Bescheid, wenn du was hörst!

bye.sl: Na svidenje. Ob dvanajstih so poročila!
bye.en: Goodbye. The news is at twelve!
bye.de: Auf Wiedersehen. Um zwölf kommen die Nachrichten!
bye.it: Arrivederci. Alle dodici c'è il notiziario!

bye.sl: Lahko noč. Zapri okno, burja bo.
bye.en: Good night. Close the window, there will be burja.
bye.de: Gute Nacht. Mach das Fenster zu, die Bora kommt.
bye.it: Buonanotte. Chiudi la finestra, arriva la bora.

bye.sl: Lep dan! Radio pravi, da bo sončno.
bye.en: Have a nice day! The radio says it will be sunny.
bye.de: Einen schönen Tag! Das Radio sagt, es wird sonnig.
bye.it: Buona giornata! La radio dice che ci sarà il sole.

liked.sl: Kaj? Zame? O, {learner}! To imam pa res rada!
liked.en: What? For me? Oh, {learner}! I really love this!
liked.de: Was? Für mich? Oh, {learner}! Das mag ich wirklich sehr!
liked.it: Cosa? Per me? Oh, {learner}! Questo mi piace proprio tanto!

liked.sl: Kako si {m:vedel|f:vedela}, da imam to rada? To povem vsej vasi!
liked.en: How did you know I like this? I'll tell the whole village!
liked.de: Woher wusstest du, dass ich das mag? Das erzähle ich dem ganzen Dorf!
liked.it: Come sapevi che mi piace? Lo racconto a tutto il paese!

liked.sl: {learner}, {m:moj|f:moja}! Točno to! Sedi in povej, kje si to {m:dobil|f:dobila}.
liked.en: {learner}, my dear! Exactly this! Sit down and tell me where you got it.
liked.de: {learner}, {m:mein Lieber|f:meine Liebe}! Genau das! Setz dich und erzähl, wo du das herhast.
liked.it: {learner}, {m:caro mio|f:cara mia}! Proprio questo! Siediti e dimmi dove l'hai preso.

ordinary.en: What? A present? Thank you, {learner}, thank you!

ordinary.sl: Hvala, {m:priden fant|f:pridno dekle}. Pridi bliže, slabo slišim.
ordinary.en: Thank you, {m:good lad|f:good lass}. Come closer, I can't hear well.
ordinary.de: Danke, {m:braver Junge|f:braves Mädchen}. Komm näher, ich höre schlecht.
ordinary.it: Grazie, {m:bravo ragazzo|f:brava ragazza}. Vieni più vicino, ci sento poco.

rare.sl: Kaj?! Tega pa v vasi še nihče nima! Hvala, {learner}!
rare.en: What?! Nobody in the village has this yet! Thank you, {learner}!
rare.de: Was?! So etwas hat im Dorf noch keiner! Danke, {learner}!
rare.it: Cosa?! In paese questo non ce l'ha ancora nessuno! Grazie, {learner}!
